ownershipRule: Exactly one route dispatcher is installed per Playwright page or in-app browser context.

scenes.reason: F04 owns the stateful authentication model; R2 does not create a second auth state machine.
F02 provides startup, session, health, project and preference projections.
Read projections remain in F02; lifecycle writes remain exclusively in F04.
F03 owns the canonical Workspace fixture and mounted owner lifecycle.
F03 exposes deterministic operator, Canvas selection and parameter validation paths.
F03 owns a shared deterministic PNG fixture, ROI coordinates and the canonical ImageCanvas/ROI lifecycle.
Save remains F03-owned and Inspection run remains F05-owned; R2 may sequence them but must not compose two dispatchers in one page.
F02 provides result list, detail, statistics and investigation projections.
Read routes are reusable from F02 and current page-level owners; command behavior stays with the existing Station command owner.
F05 owns the inspection selector and run-control fixture.
F07 owns settings, authority reconciliation and device workbench projections.
F06 owns AgentRun fixture state, stream and workspace handoff behavior.
F02 provides deterministic dense catalog and detail reads.
F02 provides service facts and public error surfaces without writes.

unavailable.reason: Current export authority supports asynchronous CSV and JSON only; R2 must not invent XLSX or a Station-specific export endpoint.
Browser DPR is not native Windows DPI.
The current developer machine is not an independent published target without Node.
